summary: MATERIAL CORRECTION / RE-ENTRY: Rico Dowdle Over 8.5 rushing attempts is again BET_NOW at bet365 -115, 0.5u, after fresh market-specific verification. Covers timestamps its Rico Dowdle board Sat Sep 19 02:19 ET and explicitly places bet365 O8.5 -115 under the Rushing Attempts section; BettingPros independently says the current consensus rushing-attempt line is 8.5 across major books. The prior PRIME PASS_AFTER_MOVE state based on a 12.5 current-access observation is superseded because current book-specific verification contradicts it; on the Covers page, 12.5 appears in the immediately preceding Receiving Yards market, not rushing attempts. Football role evidence remains supportive but uncertain: Dowdle started Week 1, led the Pittsburgh backfield with 57.8% snaps and 48.8% route share and handled the only RB red-zone carry, while Jaylen Warren had 10 carries to Dowdle's 8 and was more efficient. FantasyPros projects 11.3 carries and Dynasty Spec 12.2, but PRIME does not bet from projections alone. Pittsburgh's official Friday injury report does not list Dowdle or Warren; LT Troy Fautanu is questionable but was a full participant Friday. PRIME restores the original conservative 61% fair probability at 8.5 (fair odds about -156), producing a +7.51 percentage-point raw edge versus -115. Hard play-to remains 8.5 and max acceptable juice remains -115. Do not chase 9.5+ without a fresh distribution. Jonathan Taylor O15.5 -120 BetMGM, Dalton Schultz O41.5 -114 FanDuel and Juwan Johnson O34.5 -115 bet365 remain unchanged prior BET theses and are not duplicate alerts. No new Grok pass; no confirmed Week 2 straight ticket in bet_history.
